fieldResults.note: The manual describes the Bassman 410 as a loudspeaker enclosure driven by an external Bassman 250 head or another bass amplifier, with no built-in amplifier.

entries.document: Rockford Fosgate T1650 Power 6.5" 2-Way Euro Fit Full Range Speaker page
entries.evidence: PDP specifications: "Speaker Type: 2-Way Coax"; "Tweeter Size 1.0" (25.4mm)"; "Midrange Size 6.5" (Nominal Diameter)"; "Crossover: Built-in tweeter crossover"; 4-Ohm.

fieldResults.note: The T1650 is a 2-way coaxial with a 6.5-inch midrange and a 1-inch tweeter: 2 transducers.

entries.document: Electro-Voice Zx4 data sheet (dealer-hosted copy)
entries.evidence: Data sheet: "EVS15-SF 15" LF Transducer"; "DH3 1.25" Voice Coil, 1" Exit Compression Driver"; "Nominal Impedance: 8 Ohms"; block diagram shows a passive LPF/HPF crossover and limiter with no amplifier.

fieldResults.note: Data sheet names an EVS15-SF 15-inch LF transducer and a DH3 1-inch exit compression driver: 2 transducers; dealer host cannot promote.
Data sheet shows a passive crossover block diagram and 8-ohm input with no amplifier; dealer host cannot promote.

entries.document: NEXO PS Series brochure, PS15 pages (dealer-hosted copy)
entries.evidence: Brochure: "The 8Ω, 2-way passive design requires a single amplifier channel"; "Components LF 1x 15" (38cm) 6Ω driver HF 1x 2" throat, 3" titanium diaphragm"; "Crossover Frequencies 900Hz Passive or Active (internally switchable)"; "Nominal Impedance Passive 8 Ω".

fieldResults.note: PS15 components list one 15-inch LF driver and one 2-inch-throat HF driver: 2 transducers; dealer host cannot promote.
Brochure states an "8Ω, 2-way passive design" with passive or active crossover switching; dealer host cannot promote.
